request.query: What is the default value, limit, requirement, or documented behavior of `jest.createMockFromModule`?
request.instructions: A passage answers only if it itself states a concrete value, limit, version, or rule for `jest.createMockFromModule`. A passage that only mentions the name, or only uses it in an example without stating a rule, does not answer.

documents.title: docs/JestObjectAPI.md > Mock Modules > `jest.createMockFromModule(moduleName)`
docs/ManualMocks.md > Examples
documents.text:
The example mock shown here uses [`jest.createMockFromModule`](JestObjectAPI.md#jestcreatemockfrommodulemodulename) to generate an automatic mock, and overrides its default behavior. This is the recommended approach, but is completely optional. If you do not want to use the automatic mock at all, you can export your own functions from the mock file. One downside to fully manual mocks is that they're manual – meaning you have to manually update them any time the module they are mocking changes. Because of this, it's best to use or extend the automatic mock when it works for your needs.

To ensure that a manual mock and its real implementation stay in sync, it might be useful to require the real module using [`jest.requireActual(moduleName)`](JestObjectAPI.md#jestrequireactualmodulename) in your manual mock and amending it with mock functions before exporting it.

The code for this example is available at [examples/manual-mocks](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/tree/main/examples/manual-mocks).

documents.title: docs/UpgradingToJest30.md > Jest Mock API Changes > `jest.genMockFromModule` Removed
documents.text:
### `jest.genMockFromModule` Removed

The legacy function `jest.genMockFromModule(moduleName)` has been removed. It was previously deprecated in favor of `jest.createMockFromModule(moduleName)`. If you still use `genMockFromModule`, switch to `createMockFromModule` – the behavior is the same. For example:

Old code (Jest 29):

```js
const mockFs = jest.genMockFromModule('fs');
```

New code (Jest 30):

```js
const mockFs = jest.createMockFromModule('fs');
```
